metadata.description: The estate's architecture constitution and operational guides, packaged as installable agent plugins.

plugins.name: architecture-core
plugins.description: The architectural constitution (P1-P15), the review/modernize/recover session playbook, and the repository baseline. Install this one first; the other plugins assume it.

plugins.name: deployment-and-platform
plugins.description: Getting services deployed and kept running: Fly.io, Azure AI Foundry, Azure operations, per-PR preview environments, and customer-hosted private-cloud delivery.

plugins.name: services-and-clients
plugins.description: Recurring patterns inside services and the clients that call them: HTTP/API plumbing, identity, payments, Next.js frontends and BFFs, and browser extensions.

plugins.name: quality-and-process
plugins.description: Proving the system works and keeping the repo presentable: LLM evaluation, test strategy, E2E acceptance suites, security review, open-source release, and README badges.

plugins.name: research-standards
plugins.description: How a repository documents scientific research: the docs/research layout, the study document shape, the evidence rules, and the study and LaTeX paper templates as bundled assets.
